definitions.explanation: Remaining awake throughout the night, typically for work or study.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{徹夜|てつや}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I pulled an all-nighter before the exam.

examples.japanese: {徹夜|てつや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{終|お}わらせた→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
examples.english: I finished the work by staying up all night.

examples.japanese: {徹夜|てつや}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
examples.english: Staying up all night is bad for your health.

examples.japanese: ⟦{徹夜|てつや}{明|あ}け→徹夜明け：14910_tetsuyaake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧。
examples.english: My eyes are red from staying up all night.
examples.notes: ⟦{徹夜|てつや}{明|あ}け→徹夜明け：14910_tetsuyaake⟧ = the morning after an all-nighter

examples.japanese: ⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}わせる→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧⟦ために→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦{三日|みっか}→三日：02969_mikka⟧⟦{連続|れんぞく}→連続：03783_renzoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{徹夜|てつや}⟦したが→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦さすがに→さすがに：06356_sasugani⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦もたなかった→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: I pulled all-nighters three days in a row to meet the deadline, but my body couldn't take it.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- {徹夜|てつや}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to stay up all night)
- {徹夜|てつや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧〜⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to do ~ by staying up all night)
- ⟦{徹夜|てつや}{明|あ}け→徹夜明け：14910_tetsuyaake⟧ (the morning after staying up all night)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {徹夜|てつや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to study all night)
- {徹夜|てつや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to work all night)
- {徹夜|てつや}⟦{続|つづ}き→続き：03526_tsuzuki⟧ (staying up multiple nights in a row)

COLLOQUIAL:
- ⟦オール→オール：28484_ooru⟧ (all-nighter — casual youth slang, clipped from "all-night")
